sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October (KO 15:00). Sandbach are top of the table with 22 points from 10 games despite their most recent outing ending in defeat; they'll be looking to bounce back against struggling Alsager, who occupy the basement with just 4 points and have won only once all season.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town (Saturday 15:00), a fixture between two mid-table sides where Stafford will aim to keep pace with leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall (Saturday 15:00) in a clash between third and fifth in the table—a key match for both sides' title ambitions. Wolverhampton Casuals face Wednesfield Community at home (Saturday 15:00), followed by a midweek reverse fixture on Wednesday 7 October (KO 19:45) when Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community. Bilston Town travel to Foley Meir (Saturday 15:00) in a meeting of mid-table sides. Barnton host Shawbury United (Saturday 15:00), where Shawbury enter on the back of a run of five consecutive defeats. Market Drayton Town entertain New Mills (Saturday 15:00), both searching for consistency. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town (Saturday 15:00) in a battle between two of the division's lowest scorers. Crewe host Allscott Heath (Saturday 15:00). Finally, Brereton Social visit Widnes Town (Saturday 15:00), where bottom-of-the-table Widnes remain without a win all season.
